name: CompoundButton
summary: A tall button with a large icon, a label and a line of secondary text describing the action, for choices that need a sentence of explanation, such as the options on a start page. Use a plain button when the label says enough.

inputs.name: secondaryContent
inputs.description: The second line: a short description of what the button does.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: A 40px icon before or after the text block.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: As button; also sets the secondary text's colour.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Padding and text sizes; the height is set by content, not fixed.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: As button, but as tall as its content, with larger vertical padding.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: A 40px square icon beside the text block.

anatomy.name: Content container
anatomy.description: A column holding the label over the secondary text, left-aligned.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: The first line, in the size's text style.

anatomy.name: Secondary content
anatomy.description: The second line, regular weight, one step smaller than the label (same size at large), in Foreground 2.

variants.description: As button; secondary text Foreground 2, stepping to Foreground2Hover and Pressed.
As button; secondary text as secondary.
As button; secondary text colorNeutralForegroundOnBrand in every state.
As button; secondary text Foreground 2, Hover, Pressed (not the brand hover the label's icon gets).
As button; secondary text Foreground 2 turning Foreground2BrandHover and BrandPressed, like the label.
Padding spacingHorizontalS top and sides, spacingHorizontalMNudge bottom; label fontSizeBase300 on lineHeightBase300 at button small's regular weight; secondary text fontSizeBase200.
Padding 14px top, spacingHorizontalM sides, spacingHorizontalL bottom; label fontSizeBase300 semibold; secondary text fontSizeBase200.
Padding 18px top, spacingHorizontalL sides, spacingHorizontalXL bottom; label fontSizeBase400 on lineHeightBase400 semibold; secondary text fontSizeBase300.

layout.text: The root's height is auto: it grows with the icon and the two text lines instead of holding button's 24, 32 or 40px. Border, radius, minimum widths and the colour transition are as button.
Small pads spacingHorizontalS on top, start and end and spacingHorizontalMNudge at the bottom.
Medium pads 14px on top, spacingHorizontalM at start and end and spacingHorizontalL at the bottom.
Large pads 18px on top, spacingHorizontalL at start and end and spacingHorizontalXL at the bottom.
The icon is 40px square at every size, with spacingHorizontalM between it and the text block on the side the text is, only when there is a label.
The content container is a flex column, label over secondary text, text-aligned left.
The secondary text sets its line height to 100% of its font size, regular weight, at fontSizeBase200 for small and medium and fontSizeBase300 for large.
Icon-only compound buttons are a fixed 48, 52 or 56px wide (small, medium, large) with spacingHorizontalXS, SNudge or S padding on every side.

states.text: Rest: secondary text colorNeutralForeground2 (on-brand on primary); the root is as button.
Secondary text turns colorNeutralForeground2Hover (Foreground2BrandHover on transparent, on-brand on primary); the root is as button.
Pointer down, or active while focus-visible: secondary text turns colorNeutralForeground2Pressed (Foreground2BrandPressed on transparent, on-brand on primary).
As button: the inset colorStrokeFocus2 ring, following the root's radius.
Secondary text is colorNeutralForegroundDisabled in every state; the root is as a disabled button.

behaviour.text: Activation, focus visibility, disabledFocusable, the icon swap and the colour transition are as button.

semantics: the accessible name is the label and the secondary text together

notes.text: The 14px and 18px top paddings, the 40px icon, the 100% secondary line height and the 48, 52 and 56px icon-only widths are constants in the styles file.

Vertical padding reads horizontal spacing tokens (spacingHorizontalS, MNudge, L, XL for top and bottom), so a theme that makes the two axes differ changes compound-button heights through the horizontal tokens.
Small raises the label to fontSizeBase300 (button small uses 200) but inherits button small's regular weight, so a small compound label is 14px regular while medium is 14px semibold.
minTargetPx 40 is the smallest content-sized box: small with a label only, 8px top, a 20px line, 10px bottom and two 1px borders. With the 40px icon every size is taller.

Under forced colours secondary text turns Highlight on hover and press, HighlightText on primary, Canvas on hovered or pressed subtle, and GrayText when disabled; the root follows button's forced-colours rules.
